verdict.rationale: The evidence shows cubic issues personal or organization API keys for its Analytics API, and it has role-based access control for team members. Nothing documents issuing scoped, permission-limited, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Key types and member roles are adjacent features, not the scoped-credential capability itself, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
